signers.label: Approving Judge
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

fields.label: Petitioner
fields.prompt: Who is the petitioner on record (usually the State, e.g. "The State of San Andreas")?

fields.label: Requested By
fields.prompt: What is your name and role — you're the one requesting this warrant?

fields.label: To Be Enforced Against
fields.prompt: Who or what is this warrant being enforced against — the person or property being searched?

fields.label: Search/Seizure Subject
fields.prompt: What property is to be searched or seized (address, vehicle, etc.)?

fields.label: Items to Be Seized
fields.prompt: What items are to be seized?

fields.label: Introduction and Background
fields.prompt: Provide the introduction and background for this request.

fields.label: Reason for Affidavit
fields.prompt: In general terms, why are you seeking this warrant?

fields.label: Probable Cause
fields.prompt: What is the probable cause for this warrant?

fields.label: Criminal Code Section
fields.prompt: Which San Andreas Criminal Code section is this search related to?

fields.label: Supporting Documents
fields.prompt: List any supporting documents attached (or answer "None").

fields.label: Warrant Purpose
fields.prompt: Specifically, what do you want this warrant to authorize (e.g. "search the residence for a firearm")?

fields.label: Rank & Department
fields.prompt: What is your rank and department?

fields.label: Special Considerations
fields.prompt: Are there any special considerations the court should know about? (or answer "None")

fields.label: Approving Judge/Justice
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a judge approves the warrant — never asked of the requester.
